name: Bergman Orchards Rt 53 Catawba
description: Bergman Orchards Rt 53 Catawba is an on-farm market in 600 SE Catawba Rd, OH, selling produce straight from the field. Because everything is sold where it is grown, selection follows the local harvest calendar. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
